label: At GO in the final ~10 trials, grows with trial index after a rewarded a2-to-S2 trial.
short_terms: (phase == GO) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 88, 0) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_dec == 9) * last_is("a2 S2 r") ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_dec == 9) * (belief_lo < 0)
terms: (phase == GO) * (ep_dec == 9) * (prev_reward == 1) * (belief < 0.5) ;; (phase == GO) * np.maximum(ep_trial - 88, 0) * (prev_reward == 1) * (belief < 0.5) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_dec == 9) * (belief < 0.5) * tv("reward", -2) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_dec == 9) * (belief < 0.5) * (tv("reward", -2)==1) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_dec == 9) * np.minimum(-belief_lo, 4) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase == GO) * (ep_dec == 9) * (belief < 0.5)
explanation: Fires only at GO, and only in the last decile of the episode (timing alone gives R^2 0.25). Beyond timing, its magnitude is large when the previous trial was rewarded and the evidence favours S2 as the good state (prototype: previous trial a2 -> S2 rewarded), and it climbs roughly linearly with the trial index from about trial 89 to 99 (around 2.5 at t90 up to 4.5 at t99). After an unrewarded trial, or when belief favours S1, it stays near zero even late in the episode. The short form (test 0.49 beyond timing) uses last_is(a2 S2 r) with a late-episode ramp, plus a late belief-S2 indicator. The free fit (test 0.66) adds a separate rewarded-and-belief-S2 interaction, which needs 4-5 factors and also covers rare a1->S2 rewarded trials, plus graded belief strength and the trial before. The remaining misses are whole episodes that sit at a higher or lower level than predicted. D1 and D2 are always zero. Only observed variables are used.
